verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs describe prompt versioning with change tracking, version comparison and instant rollback. They also show deploying prompt changes without rebuilding or redeploying, by referencing prompts by ID through the AI Gateway instead of hardcoding them. A Playground for iterating on prompts is listed in the GitHub README. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt-management workflow, and detail on environment-specific (e.g. staging vs production) deployment controls.
